item.title: Maritime shipping bunkered six times more bio-LNG in the Port of Rotterdam in 2025 compared to the previous year
item.description: Last year, maritime shipping bunkered 3,000 tonnes more fuel in Rotterdam than in 2024. In total, maritime shipping bunkered 9.8 million tonnes of fuel. item.title: What is changing for shipping in 2026
item.description: With a new year comes new regulatory changes.
